name: Wyoming Building Supply
old_description: When you choose to work with us, you can expect competence, complete transparency, and an overall seamless and stress-free experience. We've been leading the renovation and window installation industry since 1976 and have the experience to prove it.
about:
Wyoming Building Supply has operated in Casper, Wyoming since 1976, establishing a showroom at 2104 Fairgrounds Road that serves as a hub for home improvement projects across the region. The company began as a renovation and window installation specialist and has expanded its scope over nearly five decades while remaining locally based.

The business provides kitchen installation, bathroom installation, window installation, and door installation, along with full-scale commercial and residential remodeling. It partners with top-tier manufacturers to supply windows, doors, countertops, and cabinets through its showroom, and its crews handle on-site measurement, installation, and cleanup. A testimonial references a phased replacement of hundreds of windows for a local multifamily property, indicating capacity for large commercial work.

Customers include both homeowners and contractors, with the website offering separate pathways for each. The company serves the residential remodeling market — kitchens, baths, and whole-home updates — as well as commercial and multifamily property managers seeking energy-efficient window and door upgrades. Concrete examples from reviews include individual kitchen and bath remodels and a multifamily window replacement project involving hundreds of units.

The company emphasizes competence, transparency, and a stress-free experience. Reviews highlight next-day measurement service, precise cabinet measurements, professional crews who clean and wash windows after installation, and transparent invoicing with no surprises. These service differentiators are cited repeatedly by both residential and commercial clients.
